abstract.text: Learn how LinkMap organizes shared places and work, use the iOS and web apps, and understand the implementation behind them.
Use the iOS handbook to create and manage work in the native app. Use the web handbook to explore Projects and Locations in a browser and to understand the website implementation.
Each Project is the root of one private or shared CloudKit hierarchy in a custom
zone. A Project share grants collaborators access to its active child records.
extensions divide read and write work by domain: Project, Location, Activity, Route, Assignment, Transaction, and sharing.
The iOS app starts on the Map and supports Project setup, Activity planning, collaboration, and resource work. This branch contains the app guide and implementation notes grounded in LinkMap-core.

The native app is a SwiftUI application backed by private and shared CloudKit Project data. MapKit renders the selected Project context. Domain-specific CloudKit helpers handle persistence, while views own the data they display.
